包厢里安静得连根针落地上都能听见。

跟在身后的关欣和马路走进包厢，两人的表情很精彩——关欣嘴巴微张，马路眼睛瞪得溜圆。

他们不是没见过能打的人，重案组天天跟凶犯打交道，抓捕行动中什么场面没经历过。

但这种利落程度，确实……超标了。

这部里的人都这么猛的吗？

两人对视一眼，同时从对方眼里读出了同一个意思——这趟差事，跟对人了。

关欣率先收回心神，和马路往前一站，将工作证亮在身前。

“市局重案组，请在座各位配合下。”关欣沉声喝道，配上他那个块头，效果拉满。

坐在主位的那个人，顾承安一眼就认出来了。

吴灿锋。

五十岁出头，面相圆润，保养得不错，穿一件花色真丝衬衫，手腕上一串小叶紫檀，左手无名指上套着个大金戒。

饭桌上的C位，永远属于买单的那个。

“什么人？光天化日的，踹门打人，还有没有王法了？”吴灿锋把筷子往桌上一拍，厉声喝道。

顾承安没理会他的质问，开口道：“吴灿锋，现在正式传唤你，跟我们走一趟吧。”

说着，他从裤兜里掏出传唤令，展开，晃了一下。

吴灿锋眯着眼看了一眼，哼了一声：“你在那晃什么，我还没看清楚呢，谁知道真的假的，现在什么骗子没有？”

他这话说得不卑不亢，带着点老油条的腔调，周围几个人甚至跟着附和了两声。

顾承安没有废话，直接上前把传唤令递到他手里。

吴灿锋接过来，低头细看。

刚开始他的表情还算从容——直到他看到落款和签章的位置。

吴灿锋的眼神凝固了。

他翻了翻传唤令的背面，又看了一遍正面，像是在确认自己没有老花看错。

圆桌旁离他最近的一个人，大概是什么生意伙伴，歪头瞄了一眼，脸色当即就变了变。

“看清楚了？”顾承安伸手，一把将传唤令收回，折好，重新塞回裤兜，“现在跟我们走，还是非要我上强制手段？”

吴灿锋默不作声。

他的眼珠转了转，大脑在高速运转——算牌面，算后路。

“我能打个电话吗？”他开口了，语气软了下来。

“不行。”顾承安干脆的拒绝了，“到案后会依法保障你的权利，现在走吧。”

吴灿锋脸上先是闪过一丝恼怒，然后迅速被一种精心维护的从容覆盖。

他站起身，整了整衣衫，转身面向桌前。

“各位，各位，”他挤出一个笑容，双手虚压了一下，“小事情，一点误会，很快就能说清楚，大家不用担心，继续吃喝，今天的单我已经结过了，想吃什么喝什么尽管点。”

桌旁的人表情各异。

有人点头表示理解，笑容比吴灿锋的还假；有人已经在桌子底下掏手机了，不知道是在搜新闻还是准备给谁通风报信……。

吴灿锋面不改色，迈步走出圆桌，走到顾承安面前站定。

近距离之下，两人身高差了半个头，但吴灿锋气势上努力维持着不落下风。

The box was so quiet that you could hear a pin drop.

Guan Xin and Malu followed behind them and walked into the box. Their expressions were very exciting - Guan Xin's mouth was slightly open and Malu's eyes were wide open.

It's not like they haven't seen anyone who can beat them. The crime team deals with criminals every day, and they have never experienced any scenes during arrest operations.

But this level of neatness is indeed... beyond the standard.

Are all the people in this movie so fierce?

The two looked at each other and read the same meaning in each other's eyes - they were with the right person for this errand.

Guan Xin took the lead to recover her mind, stopped forward with Malu, and showed her work certificate in front of her.

"City Bureau Serious Crime Team, please cooperate with everyone here." Guan Xin shouted in a deep voice, which was very effective considering his size.

Gu Chengan recognized the person sitting in the main seat at a glance.

Wu Canfeng.

He is in his early fifties, has a round face and is well maintained. He wears a colorful silk shirt, a string of small-leaf rosewood on his wrist, and a large gold ring on the ring finger of his left hand.

The C seat at the dinner table always belongs to the one who pays the bill.

"Who is it? In broad daylight, kicking down doors and beating people, is there any law left?" Wu Canfeng slapped his chopsticks on the table and shouted sternly.

Gu Chengan ignored his question and said, "Wu Canfeng, you are now officially summoned. Please come with us."

As he spoke, he took out the summons from his trouser pocket, unfolded it, and shook it.

Wu Canfeng squinted his eyes and snorted: "What are you dangling there? I haven't seen it clearly yet. Who knows if it's true or not? What kind of liar is there now?"

What he said was neither humble nor arrogant, with a bit of an old-fashioned tone, and several people around him even echoed his words.

Gu Chengan didn't waste any time and stepped forward directly to hand the summons into his hand.

Wu Canfeng took it and looked down carefully.

His expression was calm at first - until he saw where the signature and signature were.

Wu Canfeng's eyes froze.

He flipped through the back of the summons and looked at the front again, as if to make sure he was not mistaken.

The person closest to him at the round table, probably some business partner, tilted his head and glanced, and his expression immediately changed.

"Do you see clearly?" Gu Chengan stretched out his hand, took back the summons, folded it, and stuffed it back into his trouser pocket, "Come with us now, or do you have to use force on me?"

Wu Canfeng remained silent.

His eyes rolled, and his brain was running at high speed - counting cards and calculating options.

"Can I make a call?" he asked, his tone softening.

"No." Gu Chengan simply refused, "After the case is filed, your rights will be protected in accordance with the law. Let's go now."

Wu Canfeng's face first flashed with anger, and then was quickly covered by a carefully maintained calmness.

He stood up, straightened his clothes, and turned to face the table.

"Everyone, everyone," he forced a smile and pressed his hands, "little things, a little misunderstanding, will be cleared up soon. Don't worry, everyone, continue to eat and drink. I have already placed today's order, so feel free to order whatever you want to eat or drink."

The people around the table had different expressions.

Some people nodded to express understanding, and their smiles were faker than Wu Canfeng's; some people had already taken out their mobile phones under the table, not knowing whether they were searching for news or preparing to tip someone off...

Without changing his expression, Wu Can stepped out of the round table and walked to stand in front of Gu Chengan.

At close range, the height difference between the two was half a head, but Wu Canfeng tried hard to maintain his momentum and not fall behind.
